name_input: RAJOO ENGINEERS LIMITED; Rajoo Engineers Ltd.- Wonderpack Division; RAJOO ENGINEERS LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey India customs records for RAJOO ENGINEERS LIMITED (Junagadh Road, Gujarat): "Total Shipments 2220 Records detected", "Trading Partners 78", "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28". Concrete export rows actually seen (5 of 5 displayed): (1) 2026-02-27 — RAJOO ENGINEERS LIMITED → SORUTY COMERCIO E INDUSTRIA (SU) LD, Luanda, Angola, HS 84772000, B/L 1074256, port MUNDRA SEA (INMUN1), goods "PLASTIC EXTRUSION PLANT AND MACHINERY ASPER INVOICE AND PACKING LIST"; (2) 2026-02-24 — → LUUKA PLASTICS LIMITED, KAMPALA, Uganda, HS 84779000, B/L 9979986, AHEMDABAD AIR ACC (INAMD4), "PARTS OF PLASTIC EXTRUSION PLANT AND MACHINERY 6012002100 AC DRIVE 400V 37KW". Source counter: page states 2220 total shipments / 78 partners; rows actually visible to me = 5 (2 outbound exports, 3 inbound imports from Xaloy Asia Thailand and Cloeren Inc USA). Declared HS 847720/847790 match the observed export rows exactly.
domestic_evidence: Company website (rajoo.com) states "Founded in 1986 in Manavadar, Gujarat", "7 K Machine Installation Completed Successfully", "78 + Countries We Have Exported To", and news item "22 July, 2025 Rajoo successfully raised ₹160 Crore" — i.e. a listed-company-scale operation with a Gujarat plant, but no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export revenue split could be retrieved: web_search returned no results (searx connection refused) and the investor-relations/financials pages returned HTTP 301 redirects that could not be followed. Domestic supply therefore remains declared, not evidenced.
note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records with destination, HS code and B/L number — not by catalogue claims. Note the ImportKey record set is mixed-direction: the same company appears as importer (Xaloy Asia Thailand, Cloeren Inc USA, HS 84779000) and as exporter (Angola, Uganda), so 2220 is a combined import+export counter, not an export-only figure. Declared HS codes 847720/847790 are consistent with observed shipments; HS 392310 and 842240 were not observed in the visible rows and are unverified. Revenue and export-volume figures: null — no public figure retrieved, not invented. Domestic turnover/GST band: null (not public in retrieved sources). Role: manufacturer (own plant at Veraval/Shapar, Rajkot, Gujarat) — not a trader. No rejection grounds: legal entity exists and is active.
